verdict: M210 closes the P0 that revoked M207/M209. Independent Synopsys VCS reproduces the old legal bank-48 deadlock, then proves the corrected six-bit M210 path at packet 48, window 96, 737-cycle descriptor hold, terminal header chaining, stage-0 handoff under stall, partial/zero tails, and fail-closed protocol attacks. M211's 91,184,539 cycles, 1,694,275-cycle recovery, and 21,990,740 stage-0 subtotal reproduce exactly. This admits a frozen-payload isolated-FC2-frontend opportunity count, not a matched hardware speedup, complete FC2, FFN, physical, or system result.

p1.effect: The netlist meets this pre-macro DC contract but has no demonstrated physical margin. Do not call it paper PPA, post-route frequency, or robust timing.
p1.required_action: Use the now-sealed exact-SHA DC receipt as pre-macro evidence only; add Formality, propagated-clock PT, SRAM/macro integration, and post-layout margin closure before physical claims.
